scope: bounded validation engineering cost on original V4 ranking; V6 timing and checkpoint

selection.exclusion: Union of V3 64, V5/V6 48 and V7 34, with 144 distinct keys required
selection.order: per eligible cell, sort raw SHA256(prefix_with_terminator ASCII bytes + bytes.fromhex(key_sha256)), then ascending original_ordinal; take first four, deliver union sorted by original_ordinal
selection.selection_inputs: frozen validation structural roster, two registered cell labels, historical exclusions only
selection.shortfall_or_changed_source: stop, no redistribution, replacement, or change of salt

measurement.inputs: seven aligned validation sources after selection seal
checks: independent full-sort membership/order before source extraction
four-arm independent computations and source EOF
two fresh checkpoint chains with all 8 original identities in order
pairwise physical frame bytes, total bytes and concatenated SHA identical
query budget pieces conserve each append
source hashes at entry and exit plus independent observer of normal exit
measurement.primary_timing: verification_seconds + append_without_commit_seconds - direct query budget publication seconds on the same row; take max within each cell for sensitivity scenarios
separate_costs: all chunk commits including final flush
